fusions.name: Light Fletching
fusions.desc: Looses a light arrow that deals 5 wind damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its reach is 30% longer.

fusions.name: Stooping Rain
fusions.desc: Lofts 3 arrows high and spread apart; each falls on the first enemy it meets for 20 wind damage, and deals 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Take Wing
fusions.desc: Carries you 4 tiles forward in one bound. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Vantage Shift
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
